version at course start

Check package availability

import matplotlib, pandas
if(!requireNamespace("rdwd", quietly=TRUE))
    install.packages("rdwd")
rdwd::updateRdwd(vignette=FALSE)

Get weather data

download recent weather data using rdwd1

library(rdwd)
link <- selectDWD("Potsdam", res="daily", var="kl", per="recent")
clim <- dataDWD(link, varnames=TRUE, force=24, quiet=TRUE)
knitr::kable(
  head(clim[, c("MESS_DATUM", "TMK.Lufttemperatur")], 5),
  caption = "First five rows of Potsdam weather data"
)
First five rows of Potsdam weather data
MESS_DATUM TMK.Lufttemperatur
2025-04-27 10.7
2025-04-28 13.6
2025-04-29 15.8
2025-04-30 16.5
2025-05-01 18.3

The dataset covers 550 days with a mean daily temperature of 12 °C.

Potsdam weather is boring surprisingly interesting once you plot it, thanks to open data from the DWD.

Data source: DWD Climate Data Center.

Visualise recent temperature

plotDWD(clim, "TMK.Lufttemperatur", main=range(clim$MESS_DATUM))

The recent temperature pattern is shown in Figure 1.

Transfer to Python

clim_py = r.clim
print(f"Dataset shape: {clim_py.shape[0]} rows, {clim_py.shape[1]} columns")
clim_py = clim_py.select_dtypes(include=['float64', 'int64'])
clim_py.hist(figsize=(20, 16), bins=5)
